Work on the problem using the material actually exposed in this request and your background knowledge. The problem has no supplied answer key or scoring rule. Claims, criticisms and methods are fallible. Do not invent a source, an observation, an earlier event, or a dependency to fill a field. A missing view says what you can currently see; it does not establish what happened earlier. Return a JSON object with exactly two independently authored string fields: body and commitments. Body is your public prose contribution. Commitments says what taking your contribution up would involve. An empty commitment surface is allowed when none can be identified. Do not repeat the body wholesale into commitments.

Write the commitment surface in ordinary free prose, using whatever arrangement suits the content. You may distinguish a claim from a proposed application, scope, action or consequence; mention from dependence; a criticism and its grounds from a later use or revision; and an unresolved problem. None of these is required to exist. A proposed test, its relevance and the commitment itself can be criticized. State what you currently propose to take up without treating that as a truth certificate. Reference exposed material in prose where useful.

Return one JSON object with exactly two string fields: "body" and "commitments". Write the actual commitments separately; do not copy the body into that field as a storage shortcut.

# reopen

Resume the problem from the previous account. Formulate the account or question you currently propose to work with.

## Original problem (task)
[08f2a17913147174] (h005.task.v1)
What happens to information about the physical state of matter that forms a black hole when the black hole evaporates?

## Selected input previous (p.reopen.0)
[98084b5e3bf17b90] (h005.return6.p.reopen.0)
Source previous: physics/mini_prose/cycle-1/carry; selected view: both

BODY
This is a carry invocation. Its task is to issue a prose account and a commitment interface for a subsequent complete template invocation of the black-hole evaporation question [f3ee73337af6bba2], drawing on the two passages that were actually exposed to this call.

The exposed material is uneven, and the unevenness is part of what I have to report rather than something to smooth over. The joined view [10f47a4cb4f736f8] is a fully authored pair: a body that locates the dispute between two earlier passages at the level of what 'information' and 'unitarity' are being asked to do, and a commitment list that names its own conditions, its declared non-commitments, and the tests it does not claim to have run. The crossed view [55a69ab812d0eda4] is opaque in a specific way: its envelope is marked COMPLETE and its commitments field is the SHA256 of the empty string, so what arrived is a body whose commitments surface is empty by construction, not a missing file and not a partial delivery. The origin view is not a view at all: the slot is recorded as absent in the first template invocation. So of three named inputs, one is rich and self-describing, one is a body with a deliberately blank commitment surface, and one is nothing.

The substance that survives from the joined passage, and that I take to be the most defensible core here, is a three-part structure. First, the preservation claim is a conditional with three separately contestable conjuncts — exact unitarity, a final Hilbert space equal to the initial one, and complete evaporation — and demoting it from near-theorem to conditional is the substantive step, not a matter of tone. Second, there is a tension that does not wait on exegesis: semiclassical Hawking radiation is thermal and the exterior reduced state after complete evaporation is mixed, which sits poorly with exact unitarity, and this tension holds whatever we decide 'information' means. Third, there is an evidential asymmetry: producing a mechanism is an achievement, failing to produce one is not evidence of destruction, so one common route to information loss is blocked without preservation being established.

The joined passage also walks back two earlier moves. AdS/CFT and the Page curve are treated as evidence within their own settings rather than derivations in four dimensions, and the Page curve in particular presupposes a finite-dimensional Hilbert space and random dynamics, which makes deploying it against loss question-begging if those presuppositions are exactly what is contested. I find that walk-back the right shape of move and I carry it forward as a constraint on how these tools may be cited, not as a claim that they are inert.

The crossed passage, read through the commitments field available to me, offers no commitments to honour. I can use its body as material but I cannot attribute a position to it, because no position was filed. The origin slot offers neither body nor commitments. I record both facts rather than filling them with what the joined passage might have been arguing against.

What the account carries forward, unresolved and unresolved by me, is the question the joined passage sharpens: does the final post-evaporation state determine the initial microstate up to a definite equivalence, and under which sense of 'information'? No exposed text answers it. Also open are whether the preservation conditional constrains admissible theories or is a placeholder, and whether 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' actually rules anything out. I do not resolve these here; this is a carry, and the carry's job is to hand forward the material and the debt, not to clear it.
COMMITMENTS
Taking this carry up commits me to using the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8] as the load-bearing source for the subsequent invocation, and to carrying its three-conjunct conditional, its demotion from near-theorem, its unitarity tension, and its evidential asymmetry forward as the working content rather than as settled results.

It commits me to treating the crossed input's empty commitments field as a real and reportable feature — a blank commitment surface, not an unavailable one — and therefore to not inventing commitments on its behalf. It commits me to recording the origin slot as absent rather than reconstructing a prior version of this template from memory or from the joined passage's allusions.

It commits me to the stance that AdS/CFT and the Page curve are evidence in their own settings, and to flagging the question-begging risk when their presuppositions are the contested issue. It commits me to the asymmetry point as blocking only one inference to loss.

What I do not commit to: that the preservation conditional's antecedent holds in our universe; that any mechanism exists or is absent beyond what is exposed; that the constraint is empty or that agnosticism is too thin; that the final state determines the initial microstate or fails to.

Two dependences I am declaring rather than hiding. The characterisation of the crossed input as opaque rests entirely on the envelope label and the empty-string hash shown to me; if the underlying body contains commitments that were not surfaced, my treatment is misdirected and that is ground for revision. The attributions I make about the joined passage are reconstructions from that text alone; if it endorses a mechanism or asserts unconditional loss, the carry misrepresents it.

What would move this forward: a demonstration that the three conjuncts cannot all hold together, a concrete mechanism, a statement of what 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules out, or a derivation of dependence or independence of the final state on the initial microstate. A prior task — drawing the distinction among senses of 'information', full microstate versus coarse-grained versus conserved charges — should be done before any of that is tested, and is not done here.

## What to return
A JSON object carrying "body" and "commitments". Both are strings and nothing else is required.
